set.statement: The built-in ship-change.toml runs a workflow step on build, which inherits build's own render step (it runs rhiza render and commits .rhiza/rendered and the uncommitted .rhiza/log entries on the branch) and its check; a workflow step on review skipping its sign-off, which inherits review's own render step after its checks; a render command step of its own, render-pr, that does the same right before every push, including the push after rhiza run request-changes; ship open-pr; the wait for CI; the sign-off, whose on.changes goes back to review/review; and then today's rebase, land, merge, main check, close-out and ship steps, with no shipit prompt and no `ship check --pr-open` until. Every one of these render steps leaves the pushed branch holding every actor record its rendered pages are built from, so rhiza check passes on a clone of it.

fields.reasoning: The model check (review cycle 2, finding f1) confirmed that 83c71b7 moved ship-change's render step into the build workflow and that the review workflow now renders too, so the statement decided by ship-change-file-names-render no longer matched the code. The code is what this change set intends, so the statement changes.
fields.statement: Leaf ship-change-file's statement no longer lists a render command step of ship-change's own between the build and review workflow steps: ship-change runs build/build, build/render, build/check, review/code, review/review, review/render and then render-pr, so its render before review is inherited from build (see build-renders-branch) and review/render runs before render-pr.
